biomarkers.name: SSTR2 expression
biomarkers.prevalence: Usually positive in well-differentiated GI NETs, though variable by primary site and tumor grade

biomarkers.name: Chromogranin A
biomarkers.prevalence: Often elevated, but variable by tumor burden, site, secretory activity, and assay factors

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Same organoid growth as G1 but with higher proliferative index

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: GI neuroendocrine cells; subtype varies by anatomic site (for example enterochromaffin cells in many midgut NETs and ECL cells in gastric ECL-cell NETs)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Well-differentiated neuroendocrine but with higher Ki-67 (3-20%) and/or mitoses (2-20/2 mm�b2)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Intermediate position on well-differentiated GI NET spectrum
